def test(cols,names):
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dA_dt-X@c
    nmse=np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dA_dt)
    return nmse,c,names
